body.statement: For every \(f\in\mathcal F_1\) and \(u,v\in\mathbb R_+^4\), \(|F_f(u)-F_f(v)|\le(4+2/\epsilon)\lVert u-v\rVert_1\). If \(q_x,v_x\in\mathcal C_\epsilon\) for \(x\in[d]\) and \(\sum_xs(q_x)=\sum_xs(v_x)=1\), then \(W_1(\sum_xs(q_x)\delta_{\bar\tau(q_x)},\sum_xs(v_x)\delta_{\bar\tau(v_x)})=\sup_{f\in\mathcal F_1}|\sum_xF_f(q_x)-\sum_xF_f(v_x)|\).
body.justification: One simultaneous Lipschitz bound preserves unknown mass weighting and converts Wasserstein recovery into a joint moment problem.
body.gap: VinayakKongKakade2019Change controls a fixed entity-weighted paired-binomial law; its proof does not contain the mass-weighted ratio extension needed for random observational cells.
body.consumer: The inequality provides the common deterministic interface for both the empirical estimator and the grouped positive reconstruction.
